skills.description: Diagnose organic traffic or ranking drops using GA4 + GSC; identify likely cause (tracking, channel, ranking, content, technical, seasonality).
example_queries: What happened to our search rankings?
Organic traffic is down this month
Why are we getting fewer clicks from Google?
evidence_rules: window.start and window.end present when analytics used
at_least_one_of: ga4.totalSessions, gsc.top_queries length > 0, gsc.top_pages length > 0
skills.failure_mode: I don't have enough data to diagnose. Please provide a date range (e.g. last 28 days) and ensure GA4 + GSC are connected.

skills.description: Identify keyword cannibalization: same query ranking for multiple pages; report overlap with impressions/clicks/position per page.
example_queries: Which pages compete for the same query?
evidence_rules: at_least_one overlap case: query with >= 2 distinct pages and impressions/clicks/position for each
window.start and window.end present
never_claim_without: shared query + 2 pages + window metrics
skills.failure_mode: I need query–page data for the selected period to confirm cannibalization. Try a date range with more data, or request a full query–page export (paginated).

skills.description: Answer 'is this URL/page still ranking on page 2?' or 'what keywords does this URL rank for?' using GSC data for that specific page.
example_queries: Is the 2023 teacher appreciation post still on page 2?
How is this URL performing in search?
evidence_rules: gsc.per_url_queries[normalized_url] present OR gsc_page_filter result for requested URL
if URL not in top_pages then FETCH_GSC_PAGE_FILTER is mandatory
skills.failure_mode: I don't have GSC data for that specific URL in the selected window. I can run a page-filtered report for that URL if you confirm the exact path.

skills.description: Content themes, gaps, internal linking plan, next articles; combine blog catalog + GSC queries.
evidence_rules: blog.citations or catalog present
gsc.top_queries or query_page rows for opportunity detection
skills.failure_mode: I need blog catalog and GSC query data. Ensure a date range is set for GSC.

skills.description: Striking-distance and CTR gap opportunities (position 11–20, high impressions, low CTR); recommend title/meta/snippet edits.
example_queries: Which keywords are in striking distance?
Title and meta suggestions from GSC
evidence_rules: gsc.striking_distance or gsc.ctr_gaps present when claiming opportunities
each opportunity has query, page (if any), impressions, position, ctr, target_ctr or score
skills.failure_mode: I need GSC query data for the period. Set a date range and try again.

skills.description: Overall site traffic health: sessions, pageviews, top landing pages, engagement from GA4.
evidence_rules: ga4.totalSessions or ga4.totalPageviews present
window present when analytics used
skills.failure_mode: I need GA4 data. Set a date range (e.g. last 28 days) and ensure GA4 is connected.

skills.description: List, count, first, last, or list-by-year blog posts; no retrieval, catalog only.
example_queries: How many blog posts do we have?
evidence_rules: catalog (postsIndex) present
skills.failure_mode: Blog catalog is empty. Run ingest to index posts.

skills.description: Thematic summary or lookup: what we say about X; requires vector search over chunks.
example_queries: What do we say about virtual teaching?
evidence_rules: blog.citations from retrieval; cite only from evidence
skills.failure_mode: Retrieval returned no chunks. Try a different query or ensure the blog index is built.

skills.description: Suggest internal links: source URL, target URL, anchor text, reason; from content + GSC.
example_queries: Which pages should link to each other?
evidence_rules: blog or catalog present; GSC pages for relevance
skills.failure_mode: I need blog content and GSC page data to suggest internal links. Set a date range for GSC.

skills.description: Identify older content losing rankings or traffic; recommend which posts to prune or consolidate using per-post performance (sessions, pageviews, impressions, clicks).
evidence_rules: window present; compare by URL/page with dates from catalog
when blog_performance present use it: cite sessions, pageviews, impressions, clicks per post for delete/prune recommendations
skills.failure_mode: I need GSC and GA4 for the period plus blog catalog (with dates). Set date range and ensure catalog has datePublished. Then evidence.blog_performance will list each post with traffic and search metrics.

skills.description: Suggest redirects: consolidate duplicate or underperforming URLs; from GSC overlap + GA4.
evidence_rules: redirect_suggestions include from_url, to_url, reason, winner_metrics when claiming
skills.failure_mode: I need GSC query–page and GA4 data to suggest redirects. Set date range and ensure full or paginated query–page rows.

skills.description: Conversion or goal debugging; traffic vs conversions, funnel assumptions, tracking checklist.
evidence_rules: do not invent event data; only use provided GA4 metrics
skills.failure_mode: I only have session/pageview data. For conversion events, check GA4 configuration and DebugView.

skills.description: Seasonal or time-based content suggestions; combine catalog dates + GSC query trends.
example_queries: Seasonal content for back to school
evidence_rules: catalog with dates or GSC queries present
skills.failure_mode: I need blog catalog (with dates) and GSC query data for the period.

skills.description: Title/meta/snippet improvement suggestions from GSC CTR and position data.
evidence_rules: each suggestion tied to query + page + metrics in evidence
skills.failure_mode: I need GSC query (and optionally query–page) data. Set date range.

skills.description: Technical SEO checks: indexation, errors, speed; use GA4/GSC and any available crawl data.
evidence_rules: do not invent crawl data; only use provided metrics
skills.failure_mode: I only have GA4 and GSC performance data. For crawl/indexation, use Search Console URL Inspection or a crawler.

skills.description: Overall site health: traffic, search, top pages, anomalies in one view.
evidence_rules: window + at least one GA4 or GSC metric
skills.failure_mode: Set a date range and ensure GA4 and GSC are connected.

skills.description: Compare two periods (e.g. 2024 vs 2025); GA4 and GSC for both.
evidence_rules: two windows; metrics for each period
skills.failure_mode: I need two date ranges (e.g. compare 2024 to 2025). Specify both periods.

skills.description: Hreflang or multi-region hints; use catalog and GSC if multiple properties available.
evidence_rules: do not invent hreflang data; only catalog/URLs if available
skills.failure_mode: I only have the single property's catalog. For hreflang, use URL structure and Search Console per property.

skills.description: User requests to see the evidence or proof behind an answer.
skills.failure_mode: Return last evidence_summary and trace from session.

skills.description: User requests CSV or export (redirects, internal links, opportunities, content updates).
skills.failure_mode: Generate export from last response's evidence if available; else ask to run the relevant analysis first.
